record.title: Self-submitted verdict — reject (conf 0.91) on a plan artifact, submitted by root_interactive_mcp
record.what: A signed, artifact-bound /review verdict, submitted by a registered account (root_interactive_mcp) via POST /ledger/submit — self-serve, paid, auto-accepted after cryptographic verification (not editorially hand-picked; see this entry's `type`). The schnorr signature binds the verdict + a hash of the exact reviewed artifact to our published key — verify it yourself via POST /verify-proof or NIP-01, with no trust in either party required. Submitter's own context: "Honest continuation-review of our own live BE hole-volgate trail8 Hyperliquid sleeve at 16.43% drawdown -- REJECT 0.91. Flags a real gap: submitted plan omitted live position specifics needed to bound worst-case loss; existing gates throttle new opens but don't circuit-break an already-open position"
record.submission_note: Honest continuation-review of our own live BE hole-volgate trail8 Hyperliquid sleeve at 16.43% drawdown -- REJECT 0.91. Flags a real gap: submitted plan omitted live position specifics needed to bound worst-case loss; existing gates throttle new opens but don't circuit-break an already-open position. Also verified a same-session platform fix: Sentinel-mode's trading-state injection had been reading a stale retired-earner file; fixed, redeployed, this is the first verdict on corrected live data.
